summary: A static landing page and Markdown documentation for a product or open-source project, built with Astro.
description: One config file drives the landing page: hero, install commands, a demo block, features, users and sponsors, with empty sections left out. The docs section turns Markdown files into pages with a sidebar, an on-page table of contents, previous and next links, a Markdown copy of each page and llms.txt for agents. Social preview images are generated at build time, and the checks cover links, anchors and accessibility in light and dark themes. Hosting is separate: add cloudflare-pages for its deploy workflow. Search is not included.
seoDescription: A static Astro site for a product or open-source project: a landing page from one config file and Markdown docs with a sidebar, contents and llms.txt.

projectExamples.title: Command-line tool homepage
projectExamples.description: A landing page with install commands for npm, bun and Homebrew, a terminal demo and a features list, plus a getting-started guide and a configuration reference. You write the copy and the docs pages.

projectExamples.title: Library docs on Cloudflare Pages
projectExamples.description: Publish the project's site and docs from the default branch, with preview deploys for pull requests, by adding cloudflare-pages. Create the Pages project and its credentials yourself.

plain.whatItIs: A starter website for a software product: a front page that describes it and a documentation section built from text files, published as plain web pages.
